title.zh: 卷一百〇一 漢書3: 隱帝本紀上
title.en: Volume 101 Book of Later Jin 3: Emperor Yin Annals 1
title.raw: 卷一百〇一 漢書3: 隱帝本紀上 Volume 101 Book of Later Jin 3: Emperor Yin Annals 1

sentences.zh: 隱皇帝，諱承祐，高祖第二子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Yin, taboo name Chengyou, was the second son of Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yin, whose personal name was Chengyou, was Gaozu's second son.

sentences.zh: 母曰李太后，以唐長興二年，歲在辛卯，三月七日，生帝於鄴都之舊第。

translations.literal: His mother was called Empress Dowager Li. In the second year of Changxing of Tang, the year being xinmao, on the seventh day of the third month, the Emperor was born at the old residence in Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Li. In the second year of the Tang era Changxing (xinmao), on the seventh day of the third month, the emperor was born at the family's former residence in Yedu.

sentences.zh: 高祖鎮太原，署節院使，累官至檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: When Gaozu held Taiyuan, he was appointed commissioner of the military commissioner's office, and through successive promotions reached Acting Minister of the Right in the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: While Gaozu was stationed at Taiyuan, he was appointed military commissioner of the headquarters staff and rose through the ranks to Acting Minister of the Right in the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 國初，授左衛大將軍、檢校司空，遷大內都點檢、檢校太保。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, he was appointed General of the Left Guard and Acting Minister of Works, then transferred to Grand Inspector of the Inner Palace and Acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty he was made General of the Left Guard and Acting Minister of Works, then promoted to Grand Inspector of the Inner Palace and Acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 乾祐元年正月二十七日，高祖崩，秘不發喪。

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh day of the first month of the first year of Qianyou, Gaozu died, and the death was kept secret without announcing mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh day of the first month of the first year of Qianyou, Gaozu died; the court kept his death secret and did not yet announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，授特進、檢校太尉、同平章事，封周王。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the second month, he was granted Special Advancement, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the second month he was granted Special Advancement, made Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 宣制畢，有頃，召文武百僚赴萬歲殿內，降大行皇帝遺制，云：「周王承祐，可於柩前即皇帝位。

translations.literal: When the proclamation of the edict was finished, after a short while the civil and military officials of the hundred offices were summoned into the Hall of Ten Thousand Years, and the late emperor's testamentary decree was issued, stating: "Prince of Zhou Chengyou may immediately take the imperial throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: After the edict had been proclaimed, the court soon summoned the full civil and military establishment into the Hall of Ten Thousand Years and issued the late emperor's testamentary decree: "Prince of Zhou Chengyou shall take the throne at once before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 服紀日月，一依舊制。

translations.literal: The period and days of mourning dress shall all follow the former regulations."
translations.idiomatic: The mourning period and observances shall follow the established regulations."

sentences.zh: 」是日，內外發哀成服。

translations.literal: " That day, mourning was proclaimed within and without, and mourning dress was assumed.
translations.idiomatic: That same day mourning was proclaimed throughout the court and the realm, and all assumed mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 初，高祖欲改年號，中書門下進擬「乾和」二字，高祖改為乾祐，至是與御名相符。

translations.literal: Earlier, Gaozu had wished to change the reign title. The Secretariat and Chancellery submitted for approval the two characters "Qianhe," but Gaozu changed it to Qianyou; now it matched his imperial name.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Gaozu had planned to change the reign title. The Secretariat and Chancellery proposed the two characters Qianhe, but Gaozu changed it to Qianyou; it now coincided with his imperial name.

sentences.zh: 甲申，群臣上表請聽政，詔答不允，凡四上表，從之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the assembled ministers submitted a memorial requesting that he assume governance; an edict replied that it was not granted. In all they submitted four memorials, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the ministers submitted a memorial asking him to take up governance; the throne replied that it was not permitted. After four such petitions, he consented.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，帝於萬歲殿門東廡下見群臣，尊母後為皇太后。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Emperor received the assembled ministers beneath the eastern corridor of the gate of the Hall of Ten Thousand Years and honored his mother as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor received the ministers beneath the eastern corridor of the Hall of Ten Thousand Years and elevated his mother to Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 己丑，徐州節度使王周卒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Wang Zhou, military governor of Xuzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Zhou, military governor of Xuzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以前晉州留後劉在明為鎮州留後、幽州馬步軍都部署，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the former acting governor of Jinzhou, Liu Zaiming, was made acting governor of Zhenzhou and overall commander of the cavalry and infantry of Youzhou, with the additional title of Acting Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Zaiming, former acting governor of Jinzhou, was appointed acting governor of Zhenzhou and overall commander of Youzhou's horse and foot forces, with the additional rank of Acting Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 是日，工部尚書龍敏卒。

translations.literal: That day, Long Min, Minister of Works, died.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Long Min, Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，右衛大將軍王景崇奏，於大散關大敗蜀軍，俘斬三千人。

translations.literal: On renchen, Wang Jingchong, General of the Right Guard, memorialized that at Dasanguan he had inflicted a great defeat on the Shu army, capturing and beheading three thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Wang Jingchong, General of the Right Guard, reported a major victory over Shu forces at Dasanguan, with three thousand enemy soldiers captured or killed.

sentences.zh: 初，契丹犯京師，侯益、趙贊皆受其命，節制岐、蒲，聞高祖入洛，頗懷反仄。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Khitan invaded the capital, Hou Yi and Zhao Zan had both accepted their orders and controlled Qi and Pu. When they heard that Gaozu had entered Luoyang, they were quite uneasy in their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Khitan seized the capital, Hou Yi and Zhao Zan had both accepted Khitan orders and held Qi and Pu. Learning that Gaozu had entered Luoyang, they grew deeply uneasy.

sentences.zh: 朝廷移贊於京兆，侯益與贊皆求援於蜀，蜀遣何建率軍出大散關以應之。

translations.literal: The court transferred Zan to Jingzhao. Hou Yi and Zan both sought aid from Shu, and Shu sent He Jian to lead an army out through Dasanguan to respond.
translations.idiomatic: The court reassigned Zhao Zan to Jingzhao. Both Hou Yi and Zhao Zan appealed to Shu for help, and Shu sent He Jian with an army through Dasanguan in support.

sentences.zh: 至是，景崇糾合岐、雍、邠、涇之師以破之。

translations.literal: At this time, Jingchong gathered the armies of Qi, Yong, Bin, and Jing to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Jingchong rallied the forces of Qi, Yong, Bin, and Jing and routed them.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，制「大赦天下，自乾祐元年二月十三日昧爽已前，所犯罪人，已結正未結正、已發覺未發覺、常赦所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On guisi, an edict stated: "A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm. For all offenders before dawn on the thirteenth day of the second month of the first year of Qianyou—whether their cases had been concluded or not, discovered or not—all crimes normally excluded from amnesty are hereby pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict proclaimed a general amnesty: for all crimes committed before dawn on the thirteenth day of the second month of the first year of Qianyou—whether cases were closed or pending, known or unknown—even offenses normally excluded from amnesty were to be forgiven.

sentences.zh: 中外文武臣僚並與加恩，馬步將士各賜優給。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without shall all receive added favor, and cavalry and infantry officers and soldiers shall each be granted generous rewards."
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials at court and in the provinces were to receive added favors, and cavalry and infantry troops were each granted generous rewards."

sentences.zh: 唐、晉兩朝求訪子孫，立為二王後」云。

translations.literal: Descendants of the Tang and Jin dynasties shall be sought out and established as heirs to the two royal houses," it said.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the Tang and Jin dynasties were to be sought out and installed as heirs to the two former royal houses," the edict concluded.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鳳翔巡檢使王景崇，遣人送所獲偽蜀將校軍士四百三十八人至闕下，詔釋之，仍各賜衣服。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Jingchong, inspection commissioner of Fengxiang, sent men to deliver to the court four hundred thirty-eight false-Shu officers and soldiers whom he had captured; an edict ordered their release and additionally granted each clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wang Jingchong, inspection commissioner of Fengxiang, sent to court 438 captured Shu officers and soldiers; the throne ordered them released and gave each a set of clothes.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎張允為吏部侍郎，以工部侍郎司徒詡為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Zhang Yun, Vice Minister of War, was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Situ Xu, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yun was transferred from Vice Minister of War to Vice Minister of Personnel, and Situ Xu from Vice Minister of Works to Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以光祿卿李式為尚書右丞，以禮部侍郎邊歸讜為刑部侍郎，以刑部侍郎盧價為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Li Shi, Director of the Imperial Household, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Bian Guichan, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Shi, Director of the Imperial Household, became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Bian Guichan moved from Vice Minister of Rites to Vice Minister of Justice; and Lu Jia from Vice Minister of Justice to Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，帝始禦廣政殿，群臣起居。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the third month, the Emperor for the first time held court in the Hall of Broad Governance, and the assembled ministers performed the ceremony of inquiry after audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the third month the emperor held his first audience in the Hall of Broad Governance, and the ministers presented their formal greetings.

sentences.zh: 殿中少監胡崧上言：「請禁砍伐桑棗為薪，城門所由，專加捉搦。

translations.literal: Hu Song, Junior Supervisor of the Palace, submitted a memorial: "I request that cutting mulberry and jujube trees for firewood be forbidden, and that the gate officers be charged exclusively with apprehending violators."
translations.idiomatic: Hu Song, Junior Supervisor of the Palace, memorialized: "I ask that felling mulberry and jujube trees for fuel be banned, and that gate officers be assigned solely to apprehend offenders."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鄴都留守、太尉、中書令、臨清王高行周進封鄴王；

translations.literal: On bingchen, Gao Xingzhou, Yedu garrison commander, Grand Commandant, Chief Councilor, and Prince of Linqing, was advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Ye;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Gao Xingzhou, Yedu garrison commander, Grand Commandant, Chief Councilor, and Prince of Linqing, was promoted to Prince of Ye;

sentences.zh: 北京留守、檢校太尉、同平章事劉崇加宋州節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、檢校太尉、同平章事史宏肇，並加檢校太師、兼侍中；

translations.literal: Liu Chong, Northern Capital garrison commander, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was additionally made military governor of Songzhou; Shi Hongzhao, overall commander of the palace guard cavalry and infantry and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was additionally made Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chong, Northern Capital garrison commander, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was also made military governor of Songzhou; and Shi Hongzhao, commander of the palace guard horse and foot and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was additionally promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 前邢州節度使安叔千以太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: An Shuqian, former military governor of Xingzhou, retired with the title of Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: An Shuqian, former military governor of Xingzhou, retired with the title Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以右諫議大夫於德辰為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Yu Dechen, Right Remonstrating Censor, was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yu Dechen, Right Remonstrating Censor, was appointed Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河中節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令李守貞加守太傅，進封魯國公；

translations.literal: On gengshen, Li Shouzhen, military governor of Hezhong, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Chief Councilor, was made Acting Grand Tutor and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Lu;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Shouzhen, military governor of Hezhong, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Chief Councilor, was made Acting Grand Tutor and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu;

sentences.zh: 襄州節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、虢國公安審琦加守太保，進封齊國公；

translations.literal: An Shenqi, military governor of Xiangzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Duke of Guo, was made Acting Grand Guardian and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Qi;
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi, military governor of Xiangzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Duke of Guo, was made Acting Grand Guardian and enfeoffed as Duke of Qi;

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使、檢校太師、兼侍中、岐國公符彥卿加兼中書令，進封魏國公；

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing, military governor of Yanzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and Duke of Qi, was additionally made Concurrent Chief Councilor and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Wei;
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing, military governor of Yanzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and Duke of Qi, was also made Concurrent Chief Councilor and enfeoffed as Duke of Wei;

sentences.zh: 許州節度使兼侍衛親軍副都指揮使、檢校太尉、同平章事劉信加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Liu Xin, military governor of Xuzhou, deputy overall commander of the palace guard, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xin, military governor of Xuzhou, deputy commander of the palace guard, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以宰臣竇貞固為山陵使，吏部侍郎段希堯為副使，太常卿張昭為禮儀使，兵部侍郎盧價為鹵簿使，御史中丞邊蔚為儀仗使。

translations.literal: On renxu, the chief minister Dou Zhengu was made commissioner for the imperial tomb; Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made deputy commissioner; Zhang Zhao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made commissioner of rites; Lu Jia, Vice Minister of War, was made commissioner of the imperial guard of honor; Bian Wei, Censor-in-Chief, was made commissioner of ceremonial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu chief minister Dou Zhengu was appointed commissioner for the imperial tomb; Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Personnel, deputy commissioner; Zhang Zhao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, commissioner of rites; Lu Jia, Vice Minister of War, commissioner of the guard of honor; and Bian Wei, Censor-in-Chief, commissioner of ceremonial regalia.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前鳳翔節度使兼西南面兵馬都部署、檢校太師、兼侍中侯益為開封尹、加兼中書令；

translations.literal: On bingyin, Hou Yi, former military governor of Fengxiang and overall commander of southwestern forces, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Prefect of Kaifeng and additionally Concurrent Chief Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Hou Yi, former military governor of Fengxiang and overall commander of southwestern forces, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Prefect of Kaifeng and additionally Concurrent Chief Councilor;

sentences.zh: （《宋史·侯益傳》：益率數十騎奔入朝，隱帝遣侍臣問益連結蜀軍之由，益對曰：「臣欲誘之出關，掩殺之耳。

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Hou Yi in the History of Song: Yi led several dozen horsemen in flight to court. Emperor Yin sent a palace attendant to ask Yi the reason for his collusion with the Shu army. Yi replied: "Your subject wished to lure them out of the pass and then ambush and destroy them."
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Hou Yi in the History of Song: Yi fled to court at the head of several dozen horsemen. Emperor Yin sent a palace attendant to ask why he had linked up with Shu forces. Yi answered: "I meant to lure them out of the pass and destroy them in an ambush."

sentences.zh: 」隱帝笑之。

translations.literal: " Emperor Yin laughed at this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor laughed at this.

sentences.zh: 益厚賂史宏肇輩，言王景崇之橫恣，諸權貴深庇護之，乃授以開封尹、兼中書令。）〉

translations.literal: Yi lavished bribes on Shi Hongzhao and his circle, alleging Wang Jingchong's arrogance and tyranny, while the powerful deeply sheltered him; only then was Yi granted Prefect of Kaifeng and Concurrent Chief Councilor.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Yi lavished gifts on Shi Hongzhao and his allies, accusing Wang Jingchong of arrogance and abuse while the powerful protected him; only then was Yi given the posts of Prefect of Kaifeng and Concurrent Chief Councilor.)〉

sentences.zh: 西京留守、檢校太師、平章事、莒國公李從敏，夏州節度使、檢校太師、同平章事李彜殷，並加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Li Congmin, Western Capital garrison commander, Acting Grand Preceptor, Councilor of the Second Rank, and Duke of Ju, and Li Yiyin, military governor of Xiazhou, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, were both additionally made Concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Li Congmin, Western Capital garrison commander, Acting Grand Preceptor, Councilor of the Second Rank, and Duke of Ju, and Li Yiyin, military governor of Xiazhou, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, were both additionally made Concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事劉銖，鄆州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事慕容彥超，並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Liu Zhu, military governor of Qingzhou, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, and Murong Yanchao, military governor of Yanzhou, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, were both made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhu of Qingzhou and Murong Yanchao of Yanzhou, each Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, were both promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 詔改廣晉府為大名府，晉昌軍為承興軍。

translations.literal: An edict changed Guangjin Prefecture to Daming Prefecture and Jinchang Circuit to Chengxing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed Guangjin Prefecture to Daming Prefecture and Jinchang Circuit to Chengxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，靈州節度使、檢校太師、同平章事馮暉加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On wuchen, Feng Hui, military governor of Lingzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was additionally made Concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Feng Hui, military governor of Lingzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was additionally made Concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 河陽節度使武行德、滄州節度使王景、華州節度使侯章、晉州節度使王晏，並依前檢校太尉，加同平章事。

translations.literal: Wu Xingde, military governor of Heyang; Wang Jing of Cangzhou; Hou Zhang of Huazhou; and Wang Yan of Jinzhou—all retained their former rank of Acting Grand Commandant and were made Concurrent Councilors of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xingde of Heyang, Wang Jing of Cangzhou, Hou Zhang of Huazhou, and Wang Yan of Jinzhou each retained the rank of Acting Grand Commandant and was made Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 庚午，涇州節度使史懿、潞州節度使常思、同州節度使張彥威、延州節度使高允權，並依前檢校太尉，加同平章事；

translations.literal: On gengwu, Shi Yi of Jingzhou, Chang Si of Luzhou, Zhang Yanwei of Tongzhou, and Gao Yunquan of Yanzhou—all retained their former rank of Acting Grand Commandant and were made Concurrent Councilors of the Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Shi Yi of Jingzhou, Chang Si of Luzhou, Zhang Yanwei of Tongzhou, and Gao Yunquan of Yanzhou each retained Acting Grand Commandant and was made Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 澶州節度使郭從義、邢州節度使薛懷讓，並自檢校太傅加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Guo Congyi, military governor of Caozhou, and Xue Huairang of Xingzhou were both advanced from Acting Grand Tutor to Acting Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Congyi of Caozhou and Xue Huairang of Xingzhou were each promoted from Acting Grand Tutor to Acting Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 以前奉國右廂都指揮使王饒為鄜州留後。

translations.literal: Wang Rao, former overall commander of the right wing of the Fengguo Army, was made acting governor of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rao, former commander of the right wing of the Fengguo Army, was appointed acting governor of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以邠州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事王守恩為永興軍節度使，加檢校太師；

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Wang Shou'en, military governor of Binzhou, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was made military governor of the Yongxing Army and additionally Acting Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Wang Shou'en, military governor of Binzhou, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was transferred to military governor of the Yongxing Army and promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor;

sentences.zh: 以滑州節度使、檢校太尉郭謹為邠州節度使；

translations.literal: Guo Jin, military governor of Huazhou and Acting Grand Commandant, was made military governor of Binzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Jin, military governor of Huazhou and Acting Grand Commandant, was made military governor of Binzhou;

sentences.zh: 以前鎮州留後、檢校太傅白再榮為滑州節度使，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Bai Zairong, former acting governor of Zhenzhou and Acting Grand Tutor, was made military governor of Huazhou and additionally Acting Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: Bai Zairong, former acting governor of Zhenzhou and Acting Grand Tutor, was appointed military governor of Huazhou with the additional rank of Acting Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 以陜州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事趙暉為鳳翔節度使；

translations.literal: Zhao Hui, military governor of Shanzhou, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was made military governor of Fengxiang;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui, military governor of Shanzhou, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was transferred to military governor of Fengxiang;

sentences.zh: 以前河中節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事白文珂為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: Bai Wenke, former military governor of Hezhong, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was made military governor of Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Wenke, former military governor of Hezhong, Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, was appointed military governor of Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 殿中監任延皓配流鄜州，坐為劉崇所奏故也。

translations.literal: Ren Yanhao, Director of the Palace, was sentenced to penal exile in Fuzhou on account of having been impeached by Liu Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yanhao, Director of the Palace, was exiled to Fuzhou because Liu Chong had impeached him.

sentences.zh: 丙子，鄧州節度使劉重進、相州節度使王繼宏、安州節度使楊信，並自檢校太傅加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Liu Zhongjin of Dengzhou, Wang Jihong of Xiangzhou, and Yang Xin of Anzhou were all advanced from Acting Grand Tutor to Acting Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Liu Zhongjin of Dengzhou, Wang Jihong of Xiangzhou, and Yang Xin of Anzhou were each promoted from Acting Grand Tutor to Acting Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 以鎮州留後兼幽州一行馬步軍都部署、檢校太傅劉在明為鎮州節度使，加檢校太師，部署如故；

translations.literal: Liu Zaiming, acting governor of Zhenzhou, overall commander of the cavalry and infantry of the Youzhou command, and Acting Grand Tutor, was made military governor of Zhenzhou and additionally Acting Grand Preceptor, his deployment command remaining as before;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zaiming, acting governor of Zhenzhou and overall commander of Youzhou's horse and foot forces, Acting Grand Tutor, was made military governor of Zhenzhou and Acting Grand Preceptor while retaining his deployment command;

sentences.zh: 貝州節度使、檢校太傅李殷加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Li Yin, military governor of Beizhou and Acting Grand Tutor, was made Acting Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yin, military governor of Beizhou and Acting Grand Tutor, was promoted to Acting Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 定州節度使、檢校太尉孫方簡，府州節度使、檢校太傅折從阮，並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Sun Fangjian, military governor of Dingzhou and Acting Grand Commandant, and Zhe Congruan, military governor of Fuzhou and Acting Grand Tutor, were both made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fangjian of Dingzhou, Acting Grand Commandant, and Zhe Congruan of Fuzhou, Acting Grand Tutor, were both promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事李濤罷免，勒歸私第。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Li Tao, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Councilor of the Second Rank, was dismissed and ordered to return to his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Tao, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Councilor of the Second Rank, was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 時蘇逢吉等在中書，樞密使楊邠、副樞密使郭威等，權勢甚盛，中書每有除授，多為邠等所抑。

translations.literal: At this time Su Fengji and others were in the Secretariat, while Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yang Bin, Deputy Commissioner Guo Wei, and others held very great power; whenever the Secretariat had appointments to make, they were often blocked by Bin and his associates.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Su Fengji and his colleagues held the Secretariat, while Military Affairs Commissioner Yang Bin, Deputy Commissioner Guo Wei, and others wielded great power; many Secretariat appointments were blocked by Bin's faction.

sentences.zh: 濤不平之，因上疏請出邠等，以藩鎮授之，樞密之務，宜委逢吉、禹珪。

translations.literal: Tao was resentful of this and therefore submitted a memorial requesting that Bin and the others be sent out and granted frontier commands, and that the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs be entrusted to Fengji and Yugui.
translations.idiomatic: Tao resented this imbalance and memorialized that Bin and his allies be sent out to frontier commands while Military Affairs affairs be entrusted to Fengji and Yugui.

sentences.zh: 疏入，邠等知之，乃見太后泣訴其事，太后怒，濤由是獲譴。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, Bin and the others learned of it and then went before the Empress Dowager weeping and pleading their case. The Empress Dowager was angry, and Tao thereby received punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, Bin and his allies learned of it and went weeping before the Empress Dowager to plead their case. She grew angry, and Tao was punished as a result.

sentences.zh: 先是，中書廚釜鳴者數四，未幾，濤罷免。

translations.literal: Earlier, the cauldrons in the Secretariat kitchen had rung several times; before long, Tao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the cauldrons in the Secretariat kitchen had rung several times; not long afterward Tao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 西道諸州奏，河中李守貞謀叛，發兵據潼關。

translations.literal: The western circuits memorialized that Li Shouzhen of Hezhong was plotting rebellion and had raised troops to seize Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials from the western circuits reported that Li Shouzhen of Hezhong was plotting rebellion and had sent troops to seize Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，陜州兵馬監押王玉奏，收復潼關。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinsi, Wang Yu, military supervisor of Shanzhou, memorialized that Tong Pass had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi, Wang Yu, military supervisor of Shanzhou, reported the recovery of Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 定州孫方簡奏，三月二十七日，契丹棄定州遁去。

translations.literal: Sun Fangjian of Dingzhou memorialized that on the twenty-seventh day of the third month the Khitan abandoned Dingzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fangjian of Dingzhou reported that on the twenty-seventh day of the third month the Khitan abandoned Dingzhou and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以樞密使楊邠為中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、平章事，使如故；

translations.literal: On renwu, Yang Bin, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Personnel, and Councilor of the Second Rank, his commission remaining as before;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Yang Bin, Military Affairs Commissioner, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Personnel, and Councilor of the Second Rank while retaining his commission;

sentences.zh: 以副樞密使郭威為樞密使，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Guo Wei, Deputy Commissioner, was made Commissioner and additionally Acting Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Wei, Deputy Commissioner, was promoted to Commissioner with the additional rank of Acting Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 三司使王章加檢校太尉、同平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Zhang, Commissioner of the Three Departments, was made Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhang, Commissioner of the Three Departments, was made Acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 郢州刺史尹實奏，荊南起兵在境上，欲攻城。

translations.literal: Yin Shi, prefect of Yingzhou, memorialized that Jingnan had raised troops on the border and intended to attack the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shi, prefect of Yingzhou, reported that Jingnan had mobilized troops on the border and intended to attack his city.

sentences.zh: 是日，以澶州節度使郭從義為永興軍一行兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: That day, Guo Congyi, military governor of Caozhou, was made overall commander of the cavalry and infantry of the Yongxing Army command.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Guo Congyi, military governor of Caozhou, was appointed overall commander of the Yongxing Army's horse and foot forces.

sentences.zh: 時供奉官時知化、王益，自鳳翔部署前永興節度使趙贊部下牙兵趙思綰等三百餘人赴闕，三月二十四日，行次永興，思綰等作亂，突入府城，據城以叛，故命從義帥師以討之。

translations.literal: At this time the palace attendants Shi Zhihua and Wang Yi, escorting more than three hundred men-at-arms under Zhao Zan, former military governor of Yongxing in the Fengxiang deployment—including Zhao Sixuan—were proceeding to court. On the twenty-fourth day of the third month, while passing through Yongxing, Sixuan and the others mutinied, burst into the prefectural city, seized the city in rebellion, and therefore Congyi was ordered to lead troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At this time palace attendants Shi Zhihua and Wang Yi were escorting more than three hundred troops formerly under Zhao Zan, ex-governor of Yongxing in the Fengxiang command, including Zhao Sixuan, to court. On the twenty-fourth day of the third month, passing through Yongxing, Sixuan and his men mutinied, stormed the prefectural seat, and seized the city in rebellion; Congyi was therefore ordered to lead an expedition against them.

sentences.zh: 甲申，王景崇奏，趙思綰叛，見起兵攻討。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wang Jingchong memorialized that Zhao Sixuan had rebelled and that he had already raised troops to attack and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wang Jingchong reported that Zhao Sixuan had rebelled and that he had already mobilized forces to attack him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸道宮、佛寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Emperor visited Daoist temples and Buddhist monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor visited Daoist temples and Buddhist monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，東南面兵馬都元帥、兩浙節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、吳越國王錢宏倧加諸道兵馬都元帥，天策上將軍、湖南節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、楚王馬希廣加守中書令，以陜州節度使白文珂為河中府城下一行都部署。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Qian Hongzong, Grand Marshal of the southeastern forces, military governor of the Two Zhes, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Grand Marshal of all circuits; Ma Xiguang, General-in-Chief of the Heavenly Strategy, military governor of Hunan, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Prince of Chu, was made Acting Chief Councilor; Bai Wenke, military governor of Shanzhou, was made overall commander of the forces below the walls of Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Qian Hongzong, Grand Marshal of the southeast, military governor of the Two Zhes, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Grand Marshal of all circuits; Ma Xiguang, General-in-Chief of the Heavenly Strategy, military governor of Hunan, Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Prince of Chu, was made Acting Chief Councilor; and Bai Wenke, military governor of Shanzhou, was appointed overall commander of the forces besieging Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宰臣竇貞固、蘇逢吉、蘇禹珪並進封開國公。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the chief ministers Dou Zhengu, Su Fengji, and Su Yugui were all advanced in enfeoffment to Dukes Who Founded the State.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin chief ministers Dou Zhengu, Su Fengji, and Su Yugui were all enfeoffed as Dukes Who Founded the State.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，削奪李守貞在身官爵。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Li Shouzhen's current offices and titles were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Shouzhen was stripped of all current offices and titles.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎王仁裕為戶部尚書，以翰林學士、左散騎常侍張沆為工部尚書，以翰林學士、中書舍人範質為戶部侍郎，以樞密直學士、尚書比部員外郎王度為祠部郎中，並依前充職。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Wang Renyu, Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Minister of Revenue; Zhang Hong, Academician and Left Regular Attendant, was made Minister of Works; Fan Zhi, Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Wang Du, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Outer Vice Director of the Revenue Scrutiny Bureau, was made Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices—all continuing in their former duties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Renyu, chief Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Revenue, became Minister of Revenue; Zhang Hong, Hanlin academician and Left Regular Attendant, Minister of Works; Fan Zhi, Hanlin academician and Secretariat Drafter, Vice Minister of Revenue; and Wang Du, direct academician of Military Affairs and outer vice director of the Revenue Scrutiny Bureau, Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices—all while retaining their existing duties.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使尚洪遷充西南面行營都虞候，以客省使王峻為西南面行營兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Shang Hongqian, overall commander of the palace guard infantry, was made chief adjutant of the southwestern campaign headquarters; Wang Jun, commissioner of the Reception Bureau, was made overall supervisor of the cavalry and infantry of the southwestern campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Hongqian, commander of the palace guard infantry, was appointed chief adjutant of the southwestern campaign headquarters, and Wang Jun, commissioner of the Reception Bureau, overall supervisor of its horse and foot forces.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以宣徽南院使扈彥珂為左金吾上將軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Hu Yanke, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made General of the Left Golden Crow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Hu Yanke, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed General of the Left Golden Crow.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以左金吾大將軍、充兩街使、檢校太傅劉承赟為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Liu Chengyun, General of the Left Golden Crow, commissioner of the Two Streets, and Acting Grand Tutor, was made military governor of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Liu Chengyun, General of the Left Golden Crow, commissioner of the Two Streets, and Acting Grand Tutor, was appointed military governor of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以宣徽北院使薛可言為右金吾上將軍，以皇城使李暉為宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xue Keyan, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made General of the Right Golden Crow; Li Hui, commissioner of the Imperial City, was made commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xue Keyan, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, became General of the Right Golden Crow, and Li Hui, commissioner of the Imperial City, commissioner of the Southern Bureau.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，定州節度使孫方簡奏，復入於本州。

translations.literal: On yisi, Sun Fangjian, military governor of Dingzhou, memorialized that he had re-entered his own prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Sun Fangjian, military governor of Dingzhou, reported that he had re-entered his prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，方簡為狼山寨主，叛晉歸契丹，及契丹降中渡之師，乃以方簡為定州節度使。

translations.literal: Earlier, Fangjian had been chieftain of Langshan Stockade. He rebelled against Jin and submitted to the Khitan; when the Khitan surrendered the army at Zhongdu, Fangjian was then made military governor of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Fangjian had been chieftain of Langshan Stockade. He defected from Jin to the Khitan, and when the Khitan surrendered at Zhongdu he was appointed military governor of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 契丹主死，永康王嗣位，即以蕃將耶律忠代之，移方簡為雲州節度使，方簡不受命，遂歸狼山。

translations.literal: When the Khitan ruler died, Prince Yongkang succeeded to the throne and immediately replaced him with the barbarian general Yelü Zhong, transferring Fangjian to military governor of Yunzhou. Fangjian did not accept the order and therefore returned to Langshan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Khitan ruler died, Prince Yongkang succeeded him and replaced Fangjian with the Khitan general Yelü Zhong as military governor of Dingzhou, transferring Fangjian to Yunzhou. Fangjian refused the appointment and returned to Langshan.

sentences.zh: 高祖至闕，方簡歸款，復以中山命之。

translations.literal: When Gaozu reached the court, Fangjian submitted in allegiance and was again appointed to Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu reached the capital, Fangjian submitted in allegiance and was again appointed to Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 是歲三月二十七日，契丹棄定州，隳城壁，焚室廬，盡驅人民入蕃，惟余空城瓦礫而已。

translations.literal: That year, on the twenty-seventh day of the third month, the Khitan abandoned Dingzhou, destroyed the walls, burned the houses, and drove all the people into the barbarian lands, leaving only an empty city of tiles and rubble.
translations.idiomatic: That year, on the twenty-seventh day of the third month, the Khitan abandoned Dingzhou, demolished the walls, burned the buildings, and drove the entire population into Khitan territory, leaving only an empty ruin of tile and rubble.

sentences.zh: 至是，方簡自狼山回保定州。

translations.literal: At this time, Fangjian returned from Langshan to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Fangjian returned from Langshan to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決原武縣，河北諸州旱，徐州餓死民九百三十有七。

translations.literal: That month the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuanwu County; the prefectures of Hebei suffered drought; in Xuzhou nine hundred thirty-seven commoners died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River broke through at Yuanwu County, Hebei circuits suffered drought, and in Xuzhou 937 commoners died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉朔，國子監奏，《周禮》、《儀禮》、《公羊》、《穀梁》四經未有印板，欲集學官考校雕造。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, jiyou, the Directorate of Education memorialized that the four classics—the Rites of Zhou, the Etiquette and Rites, the Gongyang Commentary, and the Guliang Commentary—had no printing blocks, and that it wished to gather academic officials to collate and carve them.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, jiyou, the Directorate of Education reported that the Rites of Zhou, the Etiquette and Rites, the Gongyang Commentary, and the Guliang Commentary still lacked printing blocks, and asked to assemble scholars to collate and carve editions.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己未，回鶻遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Uyghurs sent envoys to offer tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Uyghurs sent envoys to present tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，前翰林學士徐臺符自幽州逃歸。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Xu Taifu, former Academician of the Hanlin Academy, fled back from Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xu Taifu, former Hanlin academician, escaped back from Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，河決滑州魚池。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuchi in Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Yellow River broke through at Yuchi in Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, wuyin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, wuyin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以內客省使王峻為宣徽北院使，依前永興城下兵馬都監。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Wang Jun, commissioner of the Inner Reception Bureau, was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, continuing as before as overall supervisor of the cavalry and infantry below the walls of Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Wang Jun, commissioner of the Inner Reception Bureau, was appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat while continuing as overall supervisor of the forces below the walls of Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 以冀州牢城指揮使張廷翰為冀州刺史，時廷翰殺本州刺史何行通，自知州事，故有是命。

translations.literal: Zhang Tinghan, commander of the Jizhou prison garrison, was made prefect of Jizhou. At this time Tinghan had killed the prefect He Xingtong and had himself assumed prefectural affairs; therefore this appointment was made.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tinghan, commander of the Jizhou prison garrison, was appointed prefect of Jizhou after he had killed the incumbent He Xingtong and taken charge of the prefecture himself.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以皇弟右衛大將軍承勛為興元節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事，豐州節度使郭勛加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the emperor's younger brother Chengxun, General of the Right Guard, was made military governor of Xingyuan, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank; Guo Xun, military governor of Fengzhou, was made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor's younger brother Chengxun, General of the Right Guard, was appointed military governor of Xingyuan, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank; Guo Xun, military governor of Fengzhou, was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，永興兵馬都部署郭從義奏，得王景崇報，有兵自隴州來，欲投河中，追襲至鄜城。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Guo Congyi, overall military deployment commissioner of Yongxing, memorialized that he received a report from Wang Jingchong: troops had come from Long Prefecture intending to defect to Hezhong; they were pursued and attacked as far as Fucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Guo Congyi, overall commander of Yongxing's horse and foot forces, reported that he had received word from Wang Jingchong that troops from Long Prefecture were heading to defect to Hezhong; he pursued and attacked them as far as Fucheng.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使高從誨上表歸命，從誨嘗拒朝命，至是方遣牙將劉扶詣闕請罪。

translations.literal: Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, submitted a memorial submitting to imperial authority. Conghui had once defied court orders; only now did he dispatch his adjutant general Liu Fu to the capital to plead guilty.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, submitted a memorial accepting imperial authority. He had once defied court orders; only now did he send his adjutant Liu Fu to the capital to plead guilty.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鎮州奏，節度使劉在明卒。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhen Prefecture reported that Military Governor Liu Zaiming had died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhen Prefecture reported that Military Governor Liu Zaiming had died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌。

translations.literal: On wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu.

sentences.zh: 以河陽節度使武行德為鎮州節度使，以宣徽南院使李暉為河陽節度使，以相州節度使王繼宏為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: Wu Xingde, military governor of Heyang, was appointed military governor of Zhen Prefecture; Li Hui, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed military governor of Heyang; Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Bei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xingde, military governor of Heyang, was appointed military governor of Zhen Prefecture; Li Hui, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made military governor of Heyang; and Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, was transferred to military governor of Bei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，荊南高從誨入貢謝恩，釋罪。

translations.literal: On renyin, Gao Conghui of Jingnan came to pay tribute and express gratitude; his crimes were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Gao Conghui of Jingnan came to court with tribute to express gratitude, and his crimes were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以前永興軍節度使王守恩為西京留守。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the former military governor of the Yongxing Army, Wang Shou'en, was appointed Western Capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wang Shou'en, former military governor of the Yongxing Army, was appointed Western Capital garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 是月，河北旱，青州蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Hebei suffered drought and Qing Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hebei suffered drought and Qing Prefecture had a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申朔，相州節度使王繼宏殺節度判官張易，以訛言聞。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month in autumn, wushen, Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, killed his military commissioner's adjutant Zhang Yi, and reported it on the grounds of a false rumor.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month in autumn, wushen, Wang Jihong, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, killed his adjutant Zhang Yi and reported the act on the grounds of a false rumor.

sentences.zh: 是時，法尚深刻，藩郡凡奏刑殺，不究其實，即順其請，故當時從事鮮賓客之禮，重足一跡而事之，猶不能免其禍焉。

translations.literal: At this time the law still tended toward severity; whenever a regional command submitted a request for execution, the court did not investigate the facts but simply granted the request. Therefore the staff at the time rarely observed the courtesy due to guests when serving their superiors—they walked treading in one another's footprints—and still could not escape calamity.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the law still ran harsh; whenever a regional command requested an execution, the court did not investigate but simply complied. Staff therefore rarely treated their superiors with guest courtesy—they served them treading on eggshells—and still could not escape disaster.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以工部侍郎李穀充西南面行營都轉運使。

translations.literal: On renzi, Li Gu, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed to serve as chief transport commissioner of the southwestern campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Gu, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed chief transport commissioner of the southwestern campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，禮儀使張昭上高祖廟尊號，獻舞名並歌辭，舞曲請以「觀德」為名，歌辭不錄。

translations.literal: On yimao, Ritual Commissioner Zhang Zhao submitted the honorific title for the temple of Emperor Gaozu, together with the name of the dance and its lyrics; he requested that the dance be named "Observing Virtue," and the lyrics were not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Ritual Commissioner Zhang Zhao submitted the honorific for Gaozu's temple, along with the proposed dance name and lyrics; he asked that the dance be named "Observing Virtue," and the lyrics were not recorded.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以久旱，幸道宮、佛寺禱雨，是日大澍。

translations.literal: On bingchen, because of prolonged drought, the Emperor visited Daoist temples and Buddhist monasteries to pray for rain; that day there was a great soaking rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, because of prolonged drought, the emperor visited Daoist temples and Buddhist monasteries to pray for rain; that day brought a great downpour.

sentences.zh: 開封言，陽武、雍丘、襄邑三縣，蝗為鴝鵒聚食，詔禁捕鴝鵒。

translations.literal: Kaifeng reported that in the three counties of Yangwu, Yongqiu, and Xiangyi, locusts were being gathered and eaten by crested mynas; an edict forbade the capture of crested mynas.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng reported that in Yangwu, Yongqiu, and Xiangyi counties locusts were being gathered and eaten by crested mynas; an edict forbade capturing the birds.

sentences.zh: 庚申，樞密使郭威加同平章事。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Guo Wei, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was given the additional title of Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Military Affairs Commissioner Guo Wei was additionally made Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滄州上言，自今年七月後，幽州界投來人口凡五千一百四十七，北土饑故也。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Cang Prefecture reported that since the seventh month of this year, people who had fled across the border from You Prefecture totaled 5,147—all because the northern regions were suffering famine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Cang Prefecture reported that since the seventh month of this year 5,147 people had fled across the border from You Prefecture, all because famine gripped the northern regions.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以宣徽北院使王峻為宣徽南院使，以內客省使吳虔裕為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On yichou, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Bureau; Wu Qianyu, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Southern Bureau, and Wu Qianyu, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以遂州節度使兼侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使李洪信為澶州節度使，以澶州節度使郭從義為永興軍節度使兼行營都部署。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Li Hongxin, military governor of Suizhou and commander-in-chief of the Imperial Guard Cavalry, was appointed military governor of Cao Prefecture; Guo Congyi, military governor of Cao Prefecture, was appointed military governor of the Yongxing Army and field headquarters commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Hongxin, military governor of Suizhou and commander-in-chief of the Imperial Guard Cavalry, was made military governor of Cao Prefecture, and Guo Congyi, military governor of Cao Prefecture, was made military governor of the Yongxing Army and field headquarters commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，故兵部尚書李懌贈尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the late Minister of War Li Yi was posthumously conferred the title of Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the late Minister of War Li Yi was posthumously made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 鎮州奏，準詔處斬節度副使張鵬訖。

translations.literal: Zhen Prefecture reported that in accordance with an edict, Deputy Military Governor Zhang Peng had been executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Prefecture reported that pursuant to edict, Deputy Military Governor Zhang Peng had been executed.

sentences.zh: 鵬以一言之失，為鄴帥高行周所奏，故命誅之。

translations.literal: Peng had committed a slip of the tongue and was denounced by Gao Xingzhou, Yedu garrison commander; therefore he was ordered to be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Peng had misspoken and was denounced by Gao Xingzhou, Yedu garrison commander; he was therefore ordered executed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，新授鳳翔節度使趙暉奏，與八作使王繼濤領部下兵同赴鳳翔。

translations.literal: On yihai, the newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, Zhao Hui, memorialized that he and Wang Jitao, Commissioner of the Eight Works, were leading their troops together to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhao Hui, newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, reported that he and Commissioner of the Eight Works Wang Jitao were leading their troops together to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 時王景崇拒命故也。

translations.literal: This was because Wang Jingchong was defying orders at the time.
translations.idiomatic: The move was made because Wang Jingchong was then defying court orders.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，以華州節度使侯章為邠州節度使，以左金吾上將軍扈彥珂為華州節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jimao, Hou Zhang, military governor of Hua Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Bin Prefecture; Hu Yanke, Left Golden Crow Senior General, was appointed military governor of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, Hou Zhang, military governor of Hua Prefecture, was transferred to military governor of Bin Prefecture, and Hu Yanke, Left Golden Crow Senior General, was made military governor of Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命樞密使郭威赴河中府軍前，詔河府、永興、鳳翔行營諸軍，一稟威節制。

translations.literal: On renwu, Military Affairs Commissioner Guo Wei was ordered to proceed to the army before Hezhong Prefecture; an edict commanded all field-army forces of Hezhong Prefecture, Yongxing, and Fengxiang to obey Wei's unified command.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Military Affairs Commissioner Guo Wei was ordered to the front at Hezhong, and all field armies of Hezhong, Yongxing, and Fengxiang were commanded to obey him exclusively.

sentences.zh: 時李守貞、王景崇、趙思綰連衡作叛，朝廷雖命白文珂、常思攻討河中，物議以二帥非守貞之敵，中外憂之，及是命之降，人情大愜。

translations.literal: At this time Li Shouzhen, Wang Jingchong, and Zhao Sixuan had allied in rebellion; although the court had ordered Bai Wenke and Chang Si to attack and suppress Hezhong, popular opinion held that the two commanders were no match for Shouzhen, and alarm spread within and outside the court; when this appointment was issued, public sentiment was greatly satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Li Shouzhen, Wang Jingchong, and Zhao Sixuan had allied in rebellion. Although the court had ordered Bai Wenke and Chang Si to campaign against Hezhong, opinion held that neither commander was Shouzhen's equal, and alarm spread throughout the realm; when this order came down, people were greatly relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以奉國左廂都指揮使、閬州防禦使劉詞為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使兼河中行營都虞候；

translations.literal: On guisi, Liu Ci, overall commander of the Left Wing of the Fengguo Army and defense commissioner of Lang Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Kui Prefecture and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard infantry and chief adjutant of the Hezhong field headquarters;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Liu Ci, commander of the Left Wing of the Fengguo Army and defense commissioner of Lang Prefecture, was made military governor of Kui Prefecture and appointed commander of the palace guard infantry and chief adjutant of the Hezhong field headquarters;

sentences.zh: 以護聖左廂都指揮使、岳州防禦使李洪義為遂州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Li Hongyi, overall commander of the Left Wing of the Husheng Army and defense commissioner of Yue Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Suizhou and appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongyi, commander of the Left Wing of the Husheng Army and defense commissioner of Yue Prefecture, was made military governor of Suizhou and appointed commander of the palace guard cavalry.

sentences.zh: 乙未，兩浙節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中、吳越國王錢宏俶加檢校太師、兼中書令、東南面兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Qian Hongchu, military governor of the Two Zhes, Acting Grand Commandant, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Grand Marshal of the southeastern forces.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Qian Hongchu, military governor of the Two Zhes, Acting Grand Commandant, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and King of Wuyue, was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Chief Councilor, and Grand Marshal of the southeast.

sentences.zh: 宏俶，故吳越王元瓘之子也。

translations.literal: Hongchu was the son of the former King of Wuyue, Qian Yuanguan.
translations.idiomatic: Hongchu was a son of the former King of Wuyue, Qian Yuanguan.

sentences.zh: 先是，其兄宏倧襲父位，尋為部下所廢，以宏俶代之，故特加是命焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, his elder brother Hongzong had succeeded to their father's position, but soon was deposed by his subordinates and replaced by Hongchu; therefore this special appointment was made.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier his elder brother Hongzong had succeeded their father, but was soon deposed by his own men and replaced by Hongchu; he therefore received this special promotion.

sentences.zh: 新授鳳翔節度使趙暉奏，部署兵士赴鳳翔城下。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui, the newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, memorialized that he had deployed his troops to the foot of the walls of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui, newly appointed military governor of Fengxiang, reported that he had deployed his troops beneath the walls of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，郭威奏，今月二十三日，大軍已抵河府賊城；

translations.literal: On guimao, Guo Wei memorialized that on the twenty-third day of this month the main army had already reached the rebel city of Hezhong Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Guo Wei reported that on the twenty-third day of this month the main army had reached the rebel walls at Hezhong;

sentences.zh: 至二十六日，開長連塹畢，築長連城次。

translations.literal: By the twenty-sixth day, the digging of the long linked trenches was completed, and construction of the long linked wall followed.
translations.idiomatic: By the twenty-sixth the long linked trenches were finished, and work on the long linked wall began next.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，侯益部曲王守筠自鳳翔來奔，言益家屬盡為王景崇所害。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen, Wang Shouyun, a retainer in Hou Yi's command, fled from Fengxiang and reported that all of Yi's family had been killed by Wang Jingchong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen, Wang Shouyun, a retainer in Hou Yi's command, fled from Fengxiang and reported that Wang Jingchong had killed all of Yi's family.

sentences.zh: 壬子，郭威奏，破河府賊軍於城下。

translations.literal: On renzi, Guo Wei memorialized that he had defeated the rebel army of Hezhong Prefecture beneath the walls.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Guo Wei reported a victory over the Hezhong rebel army beneath the city walls.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，故夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使尚洪遷贈太尉。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the late Shang Hongqian, military governor of Kui Prefecture and commander-in-chief of the palace guard infantry, was posthumously conferred the title of Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Shang Hongqian, late military governor of Kui Prefecture and commander of the palace guard infantry, was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雪，書不時也。

translations.literal: On yichou, snow; the annals record it as out of season.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou it snowed—recorded as an untimely occurrence.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，鳳翔都部署趙暉奏，大破川軍於大散關，殺三千餘人，其餘棄甲而遁。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Zhao Hui, overall deployment commissioner of Fengxiang, memorialized that he had inflicted a great defeat on the Shu army at Dasanguan, killing more than three thousand men; the rest cast off their armor and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhao Hui, overall commander at Fengxiang, reported a major victory over Shu forces at Dasanguan, with more than three thousand killed; the rest threw off their armor and fled.

sentences.zh: （《隆平集》：藥元福從趙暉進討，兵眾寡數倍，他將皆為卻，元福擁數百騎獨出，令曰：「敢回頭者斬。

translations.literal: (From the Longping Collection: Yao Yuanfu followed Zhao Hui in the advance to attack; the enemy forces were several times more numerous, and the other generals were all driven back; Yuanfu alone led several hundred horsemen forward and ordered: "Whoever turns back shall be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Longping Collection: Yao Yuanfu followed Zhao Hui in the advance; the enemy outnumbered them several times over and other generals were all forced back; Yuanfu alone rode out at the head of several hundred horsemen and commanded: "Whoever turns back shall be beheaded.

sentences.zh: 」眾效死以戰，遂有成功。）〉

translations.literal: " The men fought to the death, and thereby achieved success.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " His men fought to the death and won the victory.)〉

sentences.zh: 壬申，郭威奏，得郭從義報，今月十四日，鳳翔王景崇兵士離本城，尋遣監軍李彥從率兵襲至法門寺西，殺戮二千餘人。

translations.literal: On renshen, Guo Wei memorialized that he had received a report from Guo Congyi: on the fourteenth day of this month, the soldiers of Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang had left their city; he then sent the army supervisor Li Yanchong to lead troops in an attack west of Famen Temple, killing more than two thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Guo Wei reported that he had received word from Guo Congyi: on the fourteenth day of this month Fengxiang's Wang Jingchong had withdrawn his troops from the city; he then sent army supervisor Li Yanchong to strike west of Famen Temple and kill more than two thousand men.

sentences.zh: 詔升河中府解縣為解州。

translations.literal: An edict elevated Jie County of Hezhong Prefecture to Jie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict elevated Jie County of Hezhong Prefecture to Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，山陵使竇貞固上大行皇帝陵名曰睿陵，從之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month in winter, bingzi, Dou Zhengu, commissioner for the imperial tomb, submitted the name of the late emperor's tomb as Ruiling; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month in winter, bingzi, tomb commissioner Dou Zhengu submitted the late emperor's tomb name as Ruiling, and the court approved it.

sentences.zh: 丁丑夕，歲星入太微。

translations.literal: On the evening of dingchou, the Year Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of dingchou the Year Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，趙暉奏，破王景崇賊軍於鳳翔城下。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Zhao Hui memorialized that he had defeated the rebel army of Wang Jingchong beneath the walls of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhao Hui reported a victory over Wang Jingchong's rebel army beneath the walls of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吐番遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Tibetans sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Tibetan envoys presented local products at court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，右羽林將軍張播停任，坐檢田受請托也。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Zhang Bo, General of the Right Feathered Forest, was suspended from office for having accepted bribes while inspecting fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhang Bo, General of the Right Feathered Forest, was suspended for accepting bribes during field inspection.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中書舍人張誼責授房州司戶，兵部郎中馬承翰責授慶州司戶，並員外置，所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Yi, Secretariat Drafter, was demoted and appointed Registrar of Fang Prefecture; Ma Chenghan, Director of the War Bureau, was demoted and appointed Registrar of Qing Prefecture; both were appointed as supernumeraries and dispatched post-haste to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhang Yi, Secretariat Drafter, was demoted to Registrar of Fang Prefecture, and Ma Chenghan, Director of the War Bureau, to Registrar of Qing Prefecture; both were appointed as supernumeraries and sent post-haste to their posts.

sentences.zh: 先是，誼與承翰俱銜命於兩浙，睹其驕僭之失，形於譏誚，兼乘醉有輕肆之言，錢宏俶恥之，摭其過以奏之，朝廷以方務懷柔，故有是命。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yi and Chenghan had both been entrusted with missions to the Two Zhes; witnessing their arrogant transgressions, they expressed mockery, and while drunk made reckless remarks. Qian Hongchu was shamed by this and gathered their faults to memorialize the court; because the court was then pursuing a policy of conciliation, this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yi and Chenghan had both been sent on missions to the Two Zhes. Seeing their arrogance, they mocked them openly and, while drunk, spoke recklessly. Qian Hongchu, humiliated, reported their offenses to court; because the court was then pursuing conciliation, these demotions followed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，延州奏，夏州李彜殷先出兵臨州境，欲應接李守貞，今卻抽退。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yan Prefecture memorialized that Li Yiyin of Xia Prefecture had first sent troops to the border of Lin Prefecture intending to support Li Shouzhen, but had now withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yan Prefecture reported that Li Yiyin of Xia Prefecture had first sent troops to Lin Prefecture's border to support Li Shouzhen, but had now withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，誅太子太傅李崧及其弟司封員外郎嶼、國子博士嶬，夷其族，為部曲誣告故也。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the eleventh month, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Li Song and his younger brothers, Outer Director of the Directorate of Seals Li Yu and Doctor of the National University Li Yi, were executed and their clan exterminated, on account of a false accusation by their retainers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the eleventh month Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Li Song and his younger brothers Li Yu, Outer Director of the Directorate of Seals, and Li Yi, Doctor of the National University, were executed and their clan exterminated after retainers falsely denounced them.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「稔惡圖危，難逃天網；

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Having long nurtured evil and plotted danger, they could not escape Heaven's net;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Having long nurtured evil and plotted danger, they could not escape Heaven's net;

sentences.zh: 虧忠負義，必速神誅。

translations.literal: "Those who fail in loyalty and betray righteousness are swiftly struck down by the divine.
translations.idiomatic: "Those who betray loyalty and righteousness are swiftly struck down by Heaven.

sentences.zh: 李崧頃在前朝，最居重位，略無裨益，遂至滅亡。

translations.literal: "Li Song, in the previous dynasty, held the highest position yet contributed nothing, until ruin followed.
translations.idiomatic: "Li Song had held the highest office under the previous dynasty yet contributed nothing, until ruin followed.

sentences.zh: 及事契丹，又為親密，士民俱憤，險佞可知。

translations.literal: "When he served the Khitan he became their intimate; commoners and officials alike were enraged—his treachery was plain.
translations.idiomatic: "When he served the Khitan he became their intimate; officials and commoners alike were enraged, and his treachery was plain.

sentences.zh: 先皇帝含垢掩瑕，推恩念舊，擢居一品，俾列三師。

translations.literal: "The late emperor overlooked his stains and extended favor in remembrance of old ties, raising him to the first rank and placing him among the Three Preceptors.
translations.idiomatic: "The late emperor overlooked his stains and showed him favor for old ties, raising him to the first rank and placing him among the Three Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 不謂潛有包藏，謀危社稷，散差人使，潛結奸兇，俯近山陵，擬為叛亂。

translations.literal: "Who would have thought he secretly harbored designs, plotting to endanger the state, dispatching agents to link with traitors, and near the imperial tomb intending rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: "Who would have thought he secretly harbored designs against the state, dispatching agents to link with traitors and, near the imperial tomb, plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 按其所告，咸已伏辜，宜正典章，用懲奸逆。

translations.literal: "According to the accusations, all have confessed; the canonical penalties should be applied to punish these traitors.
translations.idiomatic: "According to the accusations all have confessed; canonical law should be applied to punish these traitors.

sentences.zh: 其李崧、李嶼、李鳷一家骨肉，及同謀作亂人，並從極法」云。

translations.literal: "Li Song, Li Yu, Li Yi, and all their kin, together with co-conspirators in rebellion, shall all suffer the extreme penalty," it said.
translations.idiomatic: "Li Song, Li Yu, Li Yi, and all their kin, together with co-conspirators, shall all suffer the extreme penalty," the edict concluded.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大行皇帝靈駕進發。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the imperial catafalque of the late emperor set out.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the late emperor's catafalque set out.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，荊南奏，節度使高從誨卒。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Jingnan memorialized that Military Governor Gao Conghui had died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Jingnan reported that Military Governor Gao Conghui had died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，葬高祖皇帝於睿陵。

translations.literal: On renshen, Emperor Gaozu was buried at Ruiling.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Emperor Gaozu was buried at Ruiling.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，荊南節度副使、檢校太傅、行峽州刺史高保融起復，授荊南節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事、渤海郡侯。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the twelfth month, Gao Baorong, deputy military governor of Jingnan, Acting Grand Tutor, and acting prefect of Xia Prefecture, was recalled to office and appointed military governor of Jingnan, Acting Grand Commandant, Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, and Marquis of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the twelfth month Gao Baorong, deputy military governor of Jingnan, Acting Grand Tutor, and acting prefect of Xia Prefecture, was recalled to office and made military governor of Jingnan, Acting Grand Commandant, Concurrent Councilor of the Second Rank, and Marquis of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 壬午，帝被袞冕禦崇元殿，授六廟寶冊，正使宰臣蘇禹珪及副使大府卿劉皞赴西京行禮。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Emperor, wearing full mourning robes, held court in the Hall of Supreme Origin and invested the treasure registers of the Six Temples; the chief envoy was Chief Minister Su Yugui, and the deputy envoy was Director of the Grand Storehouse Liu Hao, who proceeded to the Western Capital to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor, in full mourning dress, held court in the Hall of Supreme Origin and invested the treasure registers of the Six Temples; chief envoy Chief Minister Su Yugui and deputy envoy Director of the Grand Storehouse Liu Hao proceeded to the Western Capital to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 兗州奏，淮賊先於沂州界立柵，前月十七日已歸海州，為李守貞牽制也。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture memorialized that the Huai bandits had first built stockades on the border of Yi Prefecture; on the seventeenth day of the previous month they had returned to Hai Prefecture, restrained by Li Shouzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture reported that Huai bandits had first built stockades on the Yi Prefecture border; on the seventeenth day of the previous month they had returned to Hai Prefecture, held in check by Li Shouzhen.

sentences.zh: （《南唐書》：嗣主六年，李守貞遣從事朱元、李平奉表來乞師，以潤州李金全為西面行營招撫使，壽州劉彥貞為副；

translations.literal: (From the Book of Southern Tang: In the sixth year of the Heir's reign, Li Shouzhen sent his staff members Zhu Yuan and Li Ping to submit a memorial requesting troops; Li Jinquan of Run Prefecture was made pacification commissioner of the western campaign headquarters, with Liu Yanzhen of Shou Prefecture as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: (From the Book of Southern Tang: In the sixth year of the Heir's reign Li Shouzhen sent staff members Zhu Yuan and Li Ping to request troops; Li Jinquan of Run Prefecture was made pacification commissioner of the western campaign headquarters, with Liu Yanzhen of Shou Prefecture as deputy;

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫查文徽為監軍使，兵部侍郎魏岑為沿淮巡撫使。

translations.literal: Remonstrating Censor Zha Wenhui was made army supervisor, and Vice Minister of War Wei Cen was made commissioner for patrol along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating Censor Zha Wenhui was made army supervisor, and Vice Minister of War Wei Cen commissioner for patrol along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 聞河中平，遽班師。

translations.literal: When they heard that Hezhong had been pacified, they hurriedly withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: When they heard Hezhong had been pacified, they hurriedly withdrew.

sentences.zh: 又《李金全傳》云：出師沭陽，諸將銳於進取，金全獨以為遠不相及，乃止。）〉

translations.literal: The Biography of Li Jinquan also says: When the army marched out to Shuyang, the other generals were eager to advance, but Jinquan alone thought they were too far away to be effective and therefore halted.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The Biography of Li Jinquan also says: marching out to Shuyang, the other generals were eager to advance, but Jinquan alone judged the distance too great and halted.)〉

sentences.zh: 庚寅，奉高祖神主於西京太廟。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the spirit tablet of Emperor Gaozu was installed in the Western Capital Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Gaozu's spirit tablet was installed in the Western Capital Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 淮南偽主李璟奉書於帝，云：「先因河府李守貞求援，又聞大國沿淮屯軍，當國亦於境上防備。

translations.literal: Li Jing, the false ruler of Huainan, addressed a letter to the Emperor, stating: "Earlier, because Li Shouzhen of Hezhong requested aid, and because we also heard that the great dynasty had stationed troops along the Huai, our state likewise made defensive preparations on the border.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing, the Huainan pretender, wrote to the emperor: "Earlier, when Li Shouzhen of Hezhong sought aid, and when we also heard the great dynasty had stationed troops along the Huai, our state too made border defenses.

sentences.zh: 昨聞大朝收軍，當國尋已徹備，其商旅請依舊日通行。

translations.literal: "Yesterday we heard that the great court had withdrawn its army; our state has already lifted its defenses, and merchants are requested to pass as before.
translations.idiomatic: "Now that the great court has withdrawn its army, we have already lifted our defenses, and ask that merchants pass as before.

sentences.zh: 」朝廷不報。

translations.literal: " The court made no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The court made no reply.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，群臣上表，請以三月九日誕聖日為嘉慶節。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the assembled ministers submitted a memorial requesting that the ninth day of the third month, the day of the emperor's birth, be made the Jiaqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the ministers memorialized that the ninth day of the third month, the emperor's birthday, be made the Jiaqing Festival.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 延州節度使高允權奏，得都頭李彥、李遇等告：「太子太師致仕劉景巖與鄉軍指揮使高誌，結集草寇，欲取臘辰窺圖州城。

translations.literal: Gao Yunquan, military governor of Yan Prefecture, memorialized that he had received reports from the commanders Li Yan and Li Yu: "Retired Grand Preceptor Liu Jingyan and the local militia commander Gao Zhi have gathered bandits and intend to seize the prefectural city on the day of the year-end sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yunquan, military governor of Yan Prefecture, reported that commanders Li Yan and Li Yu had informed him: "Retired Grand Preceptor Liu Jingyan and militia commander Gao Zhi have gathered bandits and plan to seize the prefectural city on the year-end sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 尋請使臣與指揮使李勛，聊將兵士巡檢偵邏，劉景巖果出兵鬥敵，時即殺敗，其劉景巖尋獲，斬之。

translations.literal: "They then requested an envoy together with Commander Li Xun to lead a small body of troops on patrol and reconnaissance; Liu Jingyan indeed came out to fight, and was immediately defeated and killed; Jingyan was soon captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: "They then asked for an envoy and Commander Li Xun to lead troops on patrol; Liu Jingyan came out to fight, was defeated and killed, then captured and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「劉景巖年已衰暮，身處退閑，曾無止足之心，輒肆苞藏之毒，結集徒黨，窺伺藩垣。

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "Liu Jingyan, though aged and retired, had no sense of restraint and presumptuously harbored wicked designs, gathering a faction and watching the frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Liu Jingyan, though aged and in retirement, lacked restraint and harbored wicked designs, gathering followers and watching the frontier.

sentences.zh: 所賴上將輸忠，三軍協力，盡除醜類，克殄渠魁。

translations.literal: "Thanks to the loyalty of the chief commander and the concerted effort of the Three Armies, the wicked were wholly eliminated and the ringleader destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: "Thanks to the commander's loyalty and the army's concerted effort, the wicked were wholly eliminated and the ringleader destroyed.

sentences.zh: 其劉景巖次男前德州刺史行琮已行極法，長男渭州刺史行謙、孫男邢州馬軍指揮使崇勛特放。

translations.literal: "Liu Jingyan's second son, the former prefect of De Prefecture Xingcong, has already suffered the extreme penalty; his eldest son Xingqian, prefect of Wei Prefecture, and his grandson Chongxun, cavalry commander of Xing Prefecture, are specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: "Jingyan's second son, former prefect of De Prefecture Xingcong, has already been executed; his eldest son Xingqian, prefect of Wei Prefecture, and grandson Chongxun, cavalry commander of Xing Prefecture, are specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」是冬，多昏霧，日晏方解。

translations.literal: " That winter there was much haze and fog; the sun cleared only late in the day.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought heavy haze and fog; the sun did not clear until late in the day.
